title: How to use the steam clean function on an oven

pieces.say: Your oven has a cleaning setting you've never pressed.
pieces.text: Your oven has a cleaning setting you've never pressed.
pieces.label: HIDDEN SETTING

pieces.say: Here's the hidden setting. It's called Steam Clean.
Pour the water your manual says onto the cold oven floor.
When it's done, let the oven cool.
Then wipe the loosened grease with a soft sponge.
Steam burns, and don't add any cleaner to the water.
The grease just wipes away. No scrubbing.

result.say: The grease just wipes away. No scrubbing.
result.headline: Zero scrubbing

pieces.say: Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.

elevenlabsPrompt:
[playful] Your oven has a cleaning setting you've never pressed.

[intrigued] Here's the hidden setting. It's called Steam Clean.

[friendly] Pour the water your manual says onto the cold oven floor. Select Steam Clean, or AquaClean. When it's done, let the oven cool. Then wipe the loosened grease with a soft sponge. Steam burns, and don't add any cleaner to the water.

[delighted] The grease just wipes away. No scrubbing.

[warm] Daily hidden cleaning hacks, at hiddenclean dot com.
